t: Section 1956(c)(7)(D) of title 18, United States Code, is amended by inserting “section 555 (relating to border tunnels),” after “section 554 (relating to smuggling goods from the United States),”.

fable.w: This section only makes a technical amendment to the money laundering statute, adding the border tunnel offense to the list of specified unlawful activities. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading here beyond the fact that it amends a criminal statute.

opus.w: This section only adds "section 555 (relating to border tunnels)" to the list of predicate crimes for money laundering in 18 U.S.C. 1956(c)(7)(D). One might think changing a criminal law involves some outside process, but nothing in the text brings anyone outside the federal government into a federal decision.
